draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the tabular suite (all except Ivel-Fraud).
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on r1, r2, r4, r5, r6, but on r3 (Ivel-Fraud) Arbor-GBT is higher (92.8 vs 92.3). So "all six" is false; a narrower five-of-six claim is supported.
